verdict.rationale: Canva is a design product, so professional vector editing is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on pen tools, path editing, boolean operations, or precise alignment. The Apps SDK and MCP design-editing items are developer building blocks or natural-language edits, not documented vector tooling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work
